entities.name: NB-N1 mode
entities.description: A mode of operation for UEs and SMF supporting narrowband communications as defined in 3GPP TS 36.331.

entities.name: UE in NB-N1 mode
entities.description: A User Equipment operating in NB-N1 mode that calculates NAS timer values with an additional 180s offset.

entities.name: SMF supporting NB-N1 mode
entities.description: Session Management Function that supports NB-N1 mode and calculates NAS timer values with an additional 180s offset when communicating with UEs in NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: NAS timer calculation
entities.description: The process of calculating NAS timer values by adding 180s to the base timer values specified in tables 10.3.1 (for UE) and 10.3.2 (for SMF). This calculation occurs at the start of a NAS procedure and remains unchanged until the procedure completes, restarts, or aborts.

entities.name: NAS procedure
entities.description: A Non-Access Stratum procedure during which NAS timer values are calculated and used according to specification subclauses.

relations.description: UE in NB-N1 mode triggers NAS timer calculation at the start of NAS procedures
SMF supporting NB-N1 mode triggers NAS timer calculation when performing NAS signalling with UE in NB-N1 mode
NAS timer calculation is performed at the start of a NAS procedure and remains valid until procedure completion, restart, or abortion
NAS timer calculation with 180s offset is specifically defined for NB-N1 mode operation
